requirements.condition: When encoding or interpreting TXT-DATA in a TXT resource record.
requirements.required_behavior: Represent each element of TXT-DATA as a <character-string>.
requirements.why_checkable: The TXT RDATA serializer and parser can be checked for a sequence of <character-string> elements.

requirements.condition: When encoding or interpreting TXT-DATA in a TXT resource record.
requirements.required_behavior: Require TXT-DATA to contain at least one <character-string>.
requirements.why_checkable: The number of <character-string> elements in TXT-DATA can be counted to check its lower bound of one.
